payload.meta_description: Africa wedding destinations for 2027, from Kruger and the Mara to Seychelles, Marrakech and the Cape Winelands, with seasons, legal steps and guest travel.
payload.excerpt: Africa is four kinds of wedding: safari, coast and islands, winelands and North Africa. Twelve destinations ranked on setting, season, legal route, Smartraveller level and guest travel.

key_takeaways: Africa splits into four kinds of wedding (safari, coast and islands, winelands, North Africa), and South Africa covers three of them under one legal system.
Official sources set out a legal route for foreigners in South Africa, Kenya, mainland Tanzania, Seychelles and Egypt, each with its own conditions, from residence days to banns.
For Mauritius, Botswana, Victoria Falls, Zanzibar and Morocco, confirm the legal route with the embassy first, or marry at home and hold a symbolic ceremony in Africa.
Smartraveller levels as at November 2026 run from 'Exercise normal safety precautions' in four of these countries to 'Exercise a high degree of caution' in six.
Guests may face entry steps such as South Africa's traveller declaration and Kenya's ETA, so put every requirement in your guest guide early.

faq.q: What is the best month for a wedding in Africa?
faq.a: It depends on the destination. Our honeymoon guide puts safari at its best from May to October, while Smartraveller places the Seychelles monsoon from November to March and the Mauritius cyclone season from November to May. Match the month to the place first.

faq.q: Can foreigners marry legally in Africa?
faq.a: In several places, yes. Official sources set out routes for foreigners in South Africa, Kenya, mainland Tanzania, Seychelles and Egypt, each with conditions. For Mauritius, Botswana, Victoria Falls, Zanzibar and Morocco, confirm with the embassy, or marry at home first.

faq.q: Can same-sex couples marry in Africa?
faq.a: Smartraveller says same-sex marriage and civil unions are not legally recognised in Mauritius. For every other country on this list, read the local laws section of its Smartraveller page and confirm with the embassy before you choose a destination.

faq.q: How many guests can we bring to a safari wedding?
faq.a: There is no single number. It depends on how many each lodge or camp sleeps, so the guest list and the venue are chosen together. Cape Town and the Winelands suit larger weddings, and the Okavango Delta suits micro weddings and elopements.

faq.q: Is Africa safe for our wedding guests?
faq.a: Advice varies by country. As at November 2026, Smartraveller says 'Exercise normal safety precautions' for Seychelles, Mauritius, Botswana and Zambia, and 'Exercise a high degree of caution' for South Africa, Kenya, Tanzania, Zimbabwe, Morocco and Egypt. Check again before guests book.
